snippet.title: 14 NEW Characters in SMASH REMIX! (+EXTRA)
snippet.description:
Here is Smash Remix +EXTRA, an unofficial version of Smash Remix that adds 14 NEW characters to the game!

Download: https://github.com/joaorb64/smashremix-plus-extra/releases/tag/0.5.0

00:00 Intro
00:26 Birdo
01:56 Young Zelda
03:28 Mr. Game & Watch
04:58 Meta Knight
06:26 Knuckles
07:58 Snake
09:24 Cloud
10:58 Ryu
12:26 Ken
13:53 Terry
15:21 Kazuya
16:47 Ultimate DK
18:13 Spider-Man
19:42 Rebecca (Maafia's / mod creator's OC)
21:13 Outro
